task_specification.objective: Advance release convergence through three independent surfaces: repair the ordinary wave director and arena traversal contract, complete the terminal run and upgrade-choice presentation contract, and harden dense-run performance instrumentation for native recapture.

diagnosis.root_cause: The candidate has only partial ordinary-route evidence through Wave 2, leaving the data-driven five-wave/Bellkeeper transition and terminal lifecycle unqualified. Dense-run qualification remains blocked on native renderer evidence, and the upgrade page requires a player-facing visual hierarchy pass.

stop_conditions: Do not replace the preserved authored cemetery package or accepted weapon/build assets.
Do not claim Tester or host closure; stop after candidate implementation and focused self-validation are ready for recapture.
Do not spend tasks on deferred tester coverage or MCP rebind.

strategy.rationale: Partition the required gates exactly by host grouping: wave-director and spatial integrity, complete-run terminal and HUD/choice presentation, and isolated dense-performance instrumentation. Each task uses a distinct root-cause family and remains directly retestable.

code: Run parser/static checks for every modified GDScript and scene resource.
Run deterministic smoke checks for contiguous wave sequencing, single Bellkeeper request, terminal reset, upgrade transaction/debounce, and sampler lifecycle.
Verify native_godot_project and host_godot_boot checks remain passing with no new editor or runtime errors.
runtime: Tester/host recapture Waves 1-5 with ordinary movement, final-wave Bellkeeper request and defeat, Result, Retry, and resumed HUD; collect authoritative runtime state and logs at each transition.
Tester/host page-state matrix: draft-open, keyboard focus, mouse hover/focus, gamepad focus, confirm, Result, Retry, and post-selection HUD/build summary.
Tester/host dense-profile replay for three complete prepare/advance/reset cycles on native hardware; retain llvmpipe as explicit rejected or pending environment evidence if encountered.
visual: Capture shipped-camera views at spawn, critical route, central building/landmark, perimeter, and final-wave density.
Capture upgrade draft with each focus modality, confirmed rank-2 Warden Lantern HUD, Result, and clean Retry restart.
Inspect collision-aligned traversal, stable landmark visibility without disappearance or occlusion, authored card hierarchy, truthful values, and distinct focus states.

done_when: Waves 1 through 5 advance contiguously under ordinary gameplay inputs with authoritative receipts and no synthetic tester shortcuts.
Wave composition changes across the sequence, the final wave requests Bellkeeper exactly once, and no spawning continues after a terminal phase.

The authored cemetery provides larger traversable scale and a coherent external world/external depth; the central building/landmark and perimeter/boundary have aligned collision and stable visibility.
During ordinary movement/movement replay, no landmark disappearance or camera occlusion drift occurs and the player cannot pass through the collision boundary.
tasks.instructions: Repair the authoritative data-driven wave director and its final-wave Bellkeeper request timing, then validate the preserved authored cemetery as the playable spatial owner. Ensure larger traversable scale, coherent external world/external depth, and a visible central building/landmark. Verify collision alignment and a stable boundary/perimeter through ordinary movement and movement replay, with no disappearance or occlusion. Use bounded source checks and a black-box route replay for Waves 1-5; do not use diagnostic jumps as ordinary-route evidence.
tasks.title: Repair Waves 1-5 and authored arena spatial integrity

done_when: Bellkeeper is defeated through normal combat after the final-wave transition and produces a truthful victory or failure Result state with time, level, defeated enemies, damage dealt, damage taken, selected upgrades, and outcome.
Retry from Result starts a clean run with reset wave counters, actors, pickups, audio, pause ownership, result flags, and UI focus; no stale state remains.
The upgrade page uses a clear choice hierarchy or visual hierarchy with three authored cards led by silhouettes or icons, compact stat icons, and current-to-new values.
Each choice shows no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas; CURRENT values are truthful and never NEW or LOCKED placeholders, while unchanged rows are omitted.

Keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states are visually distinct, held confirm is debounced, and the authoritative selected id/rank/modifier is reflected in the resumed HUD, including the rank-2 Warden Lantern mutation.
